execution_semantics: All actions are counterfactual and are never real orders

state_feature_rationale.recent_ohlc: Completed bar information available at decision time
state_feature_rationale.returns: Causal price changes at multiple available lookbacks
state_feature_rationale.atr_14_causal: Causal range scale including gaps from previous closes
state_feature_rationale.realized_volatility_6h_causal: Recent variability using past and current completed bars only
state_feature_rationale.spread: Observed transaction-cost proxy when the source provides it
state_feature_rationale.tick_volume: Activity proxy supplied by the source
state_feature_rationale.distances: Location relative to rolling causal extrema
state_feature_rationale.regime_v0: Transparent causal classification, not a trading signal
state_feature_rationale.data_quality: Availability flags needed to interpret every record
